Subject: Post-call: missed kickoff — quick re-engage & pick a slot

Hi Alicia —

Sorry we missed you on today's kickoff — I know how calendars can spiral. We'd still love to move forward with a focused 20-30 minute technical deep dive to align on integration points and performance expectations. To make this as frictionless as possible, could you pick one of the slots below? If we don't hear back by EOD Tuesday we'll open the calendar to other prospects.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-10-12 10:00–10:30
- Tue 2026-10-12 15:00–15:30
- Wed 2026-10-13 09:00–09:30

If none of these work, reply with two windows that do and we will prioritize.

I've attached a short mutual action plan (one-pager) so you can see the minimal pre-reqs we recommend before the deep dive.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0133

Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 12KB)

Best,
